newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Seven hurt in Pakistan funeral gunfight.
newsitem.headline: Seven hurt in Pakistan funeral gunfight.

text.p: Shi'ite Moslem militants fought a gunbatle with police at the funeral of a murdered Shi'ite leader on Saturday.
Police said seven people were wounded, five of them policemen hit by automatic weapons fire from members of the militant group.
Police said they returned fire in self-defence and two passers-by were also wounded.

Sipah-i-Mohammad's leader, Murid Abbas Yazdani, was slain by unknown gunmen two days ago at his home in the national capital Islamabad. His funeral was held in Lahore, capital the central province of Punjab.
